facts.fact: Research cited by StackAdapt shows consumers, particularly millennials, are 4 times more likely to purchase from a company that is purpose-driven.

facts.fact: According to a Zeno Group study cited by StackAdapt, 94% of consumers globally say it is important that the companies they engage with have a strong purpose.
facts.quote: Globally, [94% of consumers](https://www.zenogroup.com/insights/2020-zeno-strength-purpose) say it is important that the companies they engage with have a strong purpose
